*+Defect Summary:+*

comments.body:
As per findings upon\xa0*supply_k_product_number* And {*}product_number{*}. Both are being extracted with separate xpath and logic. Further, on deep diving it is found that Product_number is 'UNKNOWN' or Not Found from Pepto Payload itself. Whereas, value for supply_k_product_number was available in payload.

Product_Number -> body.dev_productnumber OR //AMPV/ProductNo
supply_k_product_number\xa0 -> //AMPV/Supplies/Toner[Color="K"]/ModelID
